DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写生の場所をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a place to sketch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池を描きたいです。折り畳みの椅子と画板を置ける所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池の写生用椅子画板の置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to draw the pond. Is there somewhere I can put a folding chair and a drawing board?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can put a chair and drawing board to sketch the pond. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この広場の端なら、通路の外で景色を見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: At the edge of this plaza, you can enjoy the view without being in the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこを使います。午後は木の影が画板にかかりそうですが、移動してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端を選び日影に応じた移動を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will use that spot. In the afternoon, the trees' shadows will probably fall on my drawing board. May I move?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the edge and ask about moving as the shade changes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使える場所の範囲はこちらです。影を見ながら、範囲内でお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the area you can use. Choose a spot within it while keeping an eye on the shadows.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まずこの端に座ります。画板の脚も通路へ出ない位置です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定範囲で脚も通路外に設置すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will sit at this edge first. The drawing board's legs will also be positioned outside the walkway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will set up within the designated area, with the legs also outside the walkway. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水を使う場合は、周囲へこぼさないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you use water, please take care not to spill it around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は鉛筆だけです。消しゴムのかすは、この袋へまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鉛筆使用と消しかす袋回収を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am only using pencils today. I will collect the eraser shavings in this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you are using pencils and collecting eraser shavings in a bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。池の向こう側も、ここから見えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. You can see the other side of the pond from here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 橋まで見えます。最初は橋の形を描いて、影が動く前に大きい線を仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 橋が見え影が動く前に主要線を描くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can even see the bridge. I will draw the shape of the bridge first and finish the main lines before the shadows move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you can see the bridge and will draw the main lines before the shadows move. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よい時間をお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Have a pleasant time. I will leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 精算のご案内が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help adjusting your fare?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切符の金額が足りないようです。途中で行き先を変えて、ここまで来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中目的地変更で切符不足の精算を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It seems my ticket does not cover the fare. I changed my destination along the way and came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about paying the fare difference because you changed your destination along the way. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの駅から乗られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which station did you board at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この切符に書いてある駅です。改札へ入った後に、ここで友人と会うことになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車駅と入場後の待合変更を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The station written on this ticket. After I went through the ticket gate, I arranged to meet a friend here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your boarding station and the change of meeting place after entering the gate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの精算機へ切符を入れると、不足額が表示されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put your ticket into this fare adjustment machine, and the amount due will appear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入れました。不足額は百円ですね。硬貨で払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 精算機表示百円の硬貨支払を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have put it in. The amount due is one hundred yen, right? Can I pay with coins?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about paying the one hundred yen shown on the fare adjustment machine with coins. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、この受け口へ入れてください。精算後の券が出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please put them into this slot. A fare-adjusted ticket will come out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 百円入れて券を受け取りました。元の切符は機械へ戻ったままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払後券受領と元券回収を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put in one hundred yen and received the ticket. The original ticket is still inside the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you received the ticket after paying and that the original ticket was retained. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その券で改札を出られます。出口は右側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can leave through the ticket gate with that ticket. The exit is on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右の出口へ進みます。友人には、精算が終わって改札を出ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 右出口へ進み友人へ精算終了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will head for the exit on the right. I will tell my friend that I have finished adjusting the fare and am leaving the ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will head for the right exit and tell your friend that the fare adjustment is finished. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約のご相談でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の相談を予約していますが、外出の予定が変わりました。電話での相談に変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌日の対面予約を電話相談へ変更できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a consultation booked for tomorrow, but my plans for going out have changed. Can I change it to a telephone consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can change tomorrow's in-person appointment to a telephone consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当部署に確認します。予約のお時間と内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the department in charge. Please tell me the time and subject of your appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午前十時、住まいに関する相談です。書類は手元にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約時刻内容と書類所持を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is at ten in the morning, about housing. I have the documents with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the appointment time and subject, and that you have the documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 電話で扱える範囲を担当者が確認します。資料を見ながら話せる状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check what can be handled by phone. Will you be able to talk while looking at the materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、静かな部屋で書類を広げられます。資料を送る必要があれば方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 静かな資料閲覧環境と送付方法希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I can spread out the documents in a quiet room. If I need to send the materials, I would also like to ask how to do that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a quiet place to look at the materials and want to know how to send them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えます。変更が可能か、担当からご連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that request on too. The person in charge will contact you about whether the change is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし対面が必要なら、別の日へ移したいです。金曜日の午後なら来られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対面が必要なら金曜午後へ移したいと提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: If an in-person meeting is necessary, I would like to move it to another day. I can come on Friday afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest moving it to Friday afternoon if an in-person meeting is necessary. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金曜日の希望も添えておきます。現在の予約は、担当との相談後に扱いを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will include your preference for Friday. We will decide what to do with your current appointment after you speak with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は変更の返事を待ち、明日の予約を自分の判断で取り消さずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当回答待ちで予約扱いを相談後に決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. For now, I will wait for a reply about the change and will not cancel tomorrow's appointment on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the person in charge to reply and decide what to do with the appointment after consulting them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当へおつなぎします。ご連絡ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will put you through to the person in charge. Thank you for calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察前に、お伝えになることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to tell us before your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 補聴器を使っています。先生の声が聞き取りにくい時は、もう一度聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 補聴器使用と診察中の聞返し希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I use a hearing aid. If I have trouble hearing the doctor's voice, may I ask them to repeat themselves?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you use a hearing aid and want to ask for repetition during the consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もちろんです。聞こえ方で気になることはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of course. Is there anything about how you hear that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: マスク越しだと、言葉の区切りが分からないことがあります。ゆっくり話していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: マスク越しの区切り難とゆっくり話す希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sometimes I cannot distinguish where the words break when someone speaks through a mask. It would help if they could speak slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difficulty distinguishing word breaks through a mask and ask for slow speech. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診察する先生へお伝えします。大事な説明は紙でも確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the doctor examining you. Would you also like to check important explanations on paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、薬の名前や次の予定は、紙を見ながら確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬名予定の紙確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I would like to check the names of medicines and upcoming appointments while looking at a written note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check medicine names and appointments on paper. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な所を書いてもらえるようお伝えします。付き添いの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask them to write down the necessary points. Is anyone accompanying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一人です。聞こえたつもりで返事をするより、分からない所をその場で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単独受診で不明部分をその場で尋ねると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am alone today. Rather than answering as though I heard everything, I will ask about anything I do not understand right there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you are attending alone and will ask about unclear points immediately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお知らせください。お名前を呼ぶ時は、近くからもお声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do let us know in that way. When we call your name, we will also come close to speak to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。呼ばれたら補聴器を着けたまま、こちらの入口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 近くからの呼出しを受け補聴器で入口へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. When I am called, I will go to this entrance with my hearing aid still on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Respond to the offer to call you from nearby and say you will go to the entrance wearing your hearing aid. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ご案内します。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will show you the way. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どういったお電話がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What sort of phone call did you receive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない会社から、使っていないサービスの料金を払うよう電話が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未使用サービス料金の電話請求を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An unfamiliar company called and told me to pay for a service I have not used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about a telephone demand for payment for an unused service. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手は、どのように支払うよう言いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How did they tell you to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店で電子マネーを買い、番号を電話で教えるよう言いました。まだ買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電子マネー番号要求と未購入を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They told me to buy electronic money at a store and give them the number over the phone. I have not bought it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the demand for an electronic money number and that you have not bought it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 支払い前にご相談いただいたのですね。電話番号や話した時刻は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you came to ask us before paying. Do you still have their phone number and the time you spoke?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号は履歴にあります。今日の十一時ごろで、会社名はメモしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発信履歴時刻会社名メモを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The number is in my call history. It was around eleven today, and I wrote down the company name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the call history, time, and note of the company name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を伺います。相手は今も連絡してきていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask you about the details. Are they still contacting you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度切った後、同じ番号から二回着信がありました。今は出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切電後二回着信し未応答と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: After I hung up once, I received two more calls from the same number. I am not answering now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that there were two calls after you hung up and that you have not answered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 履歴とメモを見ながら、ご相談を続けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us continue the consultation while looking at the call history and your notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この画面を見せます。請求の内容を整理して、今後の対応を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面を見せ請求整理と対応相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show you this screen. I would like to organize the details of the demand and discuss how to respond from now on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the screen and ask for help organizing the demand and discussing a response. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで詳しく伺います。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will hear the details here. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何をお送りになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真を数枚送りたいです。封筒だけでは折れそうなので、包装を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真を折らずに送る包装を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to send a few photographs. They might bend in just an envelope, so I would like advice about packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about packaging to send photographs without bending them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 厚紙を添える方法があります。写真はどのくらいの大きさですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: One option is to add cardboard. How big are the photographs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この大きさで、六枚です。水にも濡れないよう袋に入れてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真六枚の大きさと防水袋を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are this size, and there are six. I have put them in a bag to keep them from getting wet too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the size of the six photographs and the waterproof bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その袋の外側へ厚紙を添えると、写真を押さえられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Putting cardboard outside that bag will keep the photographs supported.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 厚紙を二枚使って挟みたいです。封筒は一回り大きい方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 厚紙二枚で挟むため封筒サイズを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to sandwich them between two pieces of cardboard. Should the envelope be one size larger?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about envelope size for sandwiching the photographs between two pieces of cardboard. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理なく入る物を選びましょう。こちらなら、厚紙ごと入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us choose one they fit into easily. This one will hold them together with the cardboard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これにします。宛名は貼った紙ではなく、この面へ直接書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 適合封筒を選び宛名直書きを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take this one. I will write the address directly on this side rather than on a piece of paper stuck on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the suitable envelope and decide to write the address directly on it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 包装ができたら、重さと厚さを確認して料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once they are packaged, we will check the weight and thickness and tell you the postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 閉じる前に中の六枚を数えました。厚紙ごと入ったので、封をして量ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 枚数確認後に封を閉じ計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I counted the six photographs inside before closing it. They fit with the cardboard, so please seal it and weigh it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the number of photographs, ask to seal the envelope and weigh it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly, I will take it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 預金についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about a deposit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この定期預金が来月満期になります。満期後にどうなる契約か、説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来月満期の定期預金の契約扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This time deposit matures next month. I would like you to explain what the contract says will happen after maturity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the contractual treatment of a time deposit that matures next month. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 証書の内容を担当者と確認します。満期後のお金を使うご予定はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the certificate with the person in charge. Do you plan to use the money after maturity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一部を家の修理に使う予定です。見積もりはまだ出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一部修理利用予定と見積未定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to use part of it for repairs to my house. I do not have an estimate yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to use part for repairs and do not have an estimate yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な金額は未定なのですね。更新や払い戻しの条件は、契約ごとにご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the amount you need is not decided yet. We will explain the renewal and withdrawal conditions for your particular contract.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。今日は全額を払い戻すと決めずに、選べる扱いを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全額払戻しを即決せず選択肢説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than deciding today to withdraw the entire amount, I would like to know what options are available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of the options without immediately deciding to withdraw the entire amount. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの窓口で、証書を見ながらご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain at this counter while looking at your certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 満期の日に来られない場合の手続きも、聞いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 満期当日来られない場合の手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would also like to ask about the procedure if I cannot come on the maturity date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the procedure if you cannot come on the maturity date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も担当者へお伝えします。証書と、ご本人確認の書類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge about that too. Do you have the certificate and identification documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方あります。見積もりが出た後に決められるよう、今日の説明をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 証書本人確認書類を示し見積後判断用に説明をメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have both. I will take notes on today's explanation so I can decide after receiving the estimate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the certificate and identification documents and say you will take notes to decide after receiving the estimate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらへどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please come this way. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は以上でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that everything for your purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この水の箱を買います。持ち手がないので、持ち帰り方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入水箱の持ち運びを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I will buy this box of water. It has no handle, so I would like advice on taking it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about carrying home the box of water you are buying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自転車です。かごに箱ごとは入らないので、六本を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自転車かごに箱が入らず六本分割を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: By bicycle. The whole box will not fit in the basket, so I would like to separate the six bottles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the box will not fit in the bicycle basket and that you want to divide the six bottles. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱を開ける台はこちらです。袋を使う場合は、二袋に分けることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is a counter for opening the box. If you use bags, you can divide them between two bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 丈夫な袋を二枚お願いします。三本ずつ分けて、二袋とも自転車のかごに収まるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二袋に各三本を分け両袋の自転車かご内収納を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two sturdy bags, please. I will put three bottles in each and check whether both bags fit in my bicycle basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will divide the bottles into two bags of three and check that both fit in the bicycle basket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋二枚を追加します。合計をこちらでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will add two bags. Please check the total here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認しました。袋代も含めて払います。台で箱を開けてよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋代含め支払い開梱台を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked it. I will pay including the bag charge. I can open the box at the counter, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pay including the bag charge and confirm the counter for opening the box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。空いた箱は回収場所へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please take the empty box to the collection point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二袋ともかごの中へ収まり、固定できました。空いた箱を回収場所へ出してから、このまま帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両袋のかご収納固定を確認し空箱回収後に帰ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both bags fit inside the basket, and I have secured them. I will take the empty box to the collection point, then head straight home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that both bags fit securely in the basket and say you will go home after taking the empty box for collection. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the flower bed, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紫の花の名前を知りたいです。家で調べたいのですが、名札が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紫花の名前と名札の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to know the name of this purple flower. I want to look it up at home, but I cannot find a name label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the purple flower's name and the location of its label. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらはサルビアです。名札は花壇の反対側にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is salvia. The label is on the opposite side of the flower bed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 反対側にもあるのですね。この細い葉の株も同じ花ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 細葉の隣株も同花か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is one on the other side, then. Is this plant with narrow leaves the same flower too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the neighboring plant with narrow leaves is the same flower. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 葉の形が違うので、別の株です。そちらの札も一緒にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The leaf shapes are different, so it is a different plant. I will show you its label too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二種類あると分かりました。花だけでなく、葉も写真に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二種類の花葉写真を残す希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Now I know there are two kinds. I would like to photograph the leaves as well as the flowers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want photographs of both kinds of flowers and their leaves. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路から撮ると、両方の形が見えますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can see both shapes if you take the photo from the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここから撮れました。名札の名前も一枚撮って、写真と照らし合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路撮影と名札写真の照合を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I managed to take it from here. I will also take a photo of the name on the label and compare it with the photographs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Talk about taking photos from the walkway and comparing them with a photo of the label. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名前を記録すると、後で調べやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Recording the names makes it easier to look them up later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰って二種類の違いを調べます。今日は葉の形にも気づけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰宅後に二種差を調べ葉形へ気づいたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look up the differences between the two kinds when I get home. Today I noticed the shape of the leaves too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will look up the differences between the two kinds at home and noticed the leaf shapes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、お散歩の続きをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the rest of your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車のご案内でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この駅で降りたいのですが、次の快速は止まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目的駅に快速が停車するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to get off at this station. Does the next rapid train stop there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the rapid train stops at your destination station. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き先の駅はこちらですね。快速は通過します。各駅停車をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is your destination station, right? The rapid train passes through. Please take a local train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 各駅停車ですね。電光板の下の列が、その列車ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各停の電光板行を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: A local train, then. Is the lower row on the electronic board that train?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm which row on the electronic board is the local train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、七分後の列車です。同じホームから発車します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, it is the train in seven minutes. It leaves from the same platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗り場を変えずに待てますね。先の快速が来ても乗らず、七分後の列車を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同ホームで快速を見送り七分後各停を待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I can wait without changing platforms. I will not board the rapid train that comes first, and will wait for the train in seven minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will let the rapid train pass and wait on the same platform for the local train in seven minutes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列車の側面にも種別が表示されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The service type is also shown on the side of the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示で各駅停車と確かめてから乗ります。降りるまで何駅ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 種別確認と目的地までの駅数を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check that the display says local before boarding. How many stations is it until I get off?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the service type and ask how many stations it is to your destination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三駅です。車内の表示でも駅名をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Three stations. Please also check the station name on the display inside the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三駅先ですね。駅名をメモしたので、車内でも表示を見て降ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三駅先の駅名を記録し車内表示で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Three stations ahead, then. I have written down the station name, so I will check the display inside the train too before getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have recorded the station name three stops ahead and will check the onboard display. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
